description: Full keyboard and mouse USB HID gadget for CardputerZero

store.summary: Turn Cardputer Zero into a USB keyboard and mouse for a connected computer.
store.description:
Cardputer Zero HID will present the built-in keyboard as a standard USB HID keyboard and mouse composite device to a host PC. M0 is scaffold-only in this release — no HID functionality yet.

Prerequisites on device
1. Slide the USB switch to Slave (green LED off).
2. Use a data-capable USB-C cable on the right-side Type-C port.

Packaging follows the CardputerZero app store conventions used by Jiggler (intGus/jiggler, MIT).
